name: Zurich school leaver finding a 2027 commercial apprenticeship

context.occupation: School leaver seeking commercial apprenticeship KV
context.employment_state: At school, searching with family support
constraints: Opening alerts are not closing-date reminders
context.company_awareness: Recognizes banks, insurers and city administration but has no settled industry choice.

trigger: A family discussion about life after school leads to the first KV search, where different industries and application windows are hard to compare.

searches_run.observation: Retrieved cantonal apprenticeship listings, public and private employers, and general job boards. KV listings span training branches rather than one uniform office job.
Direct city-employer inspection shows staggered application windows, application caps and conditional later rounds. A single yearly deadline would misrepresent this particular employer's process.

best_entry_page.promise: Discover covered Zurich KV training employers by branch and connect each option to original 2027 intake and application information.
best_entry_page.cta: Explore employers together, then save free apprenticeship searches in the applicant's own account.
proof_needed: KV apprenticeship coverage and correct 2027 start extraction
EFZ/EBA and branch distinctions with source links
Opening windows versus deadlines, including conditional rounds
Verify account-age requirements before youth-specific onboarding claims
No unverified family collaboration or reminder features

conversion_objections: I do not know which KV branch suits me.
My family helps, but do we need shared access?
Does a 2027 title mean applications are open today?
Why use this instead of the cantonal apprenticeship portal?
Will alerts miss a reopening of the same listing?

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
